abilitySections.title: When nearby Bleeding Opponents
content: For every stack of Bleed on the opponent, generates 7% of a Bar of Power per second.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: When against Dimensional Beings, Danger Sense activates and grants Blade [9,151.2] Attack Rating while also reducing the opponent's Ability Accuracy by 40%. The Ability Accuracy reduction bypasses immunities to Ability Accuracy reduction.
Blade's immune system attacks alien substances, shrugging off Debuffs up to 95% faster based on current Power.

content: 100% chance to inflict Bleed, dealing [3,431.7] Direct Damage over 2 seconds.

content: Inflicts Bleed, dealing [11,439] Direct Damage over 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: This attack receives [2,750] additional Critical Rating.
Inflicts Bleed on Critical Hits, dealing [2,001.82] Direct Damage per stack over 1 second. For each Bleed inflicted, Blade instantly generates 8% of a Bar of Power.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
